quotations.old_english: Hí Dryhtnes ǽ feódon þurh firencræft
quotations.english: they hated the Lord's law in their wickedness

source_text: firen-cræft, es; m. A sinful craft, wickedness; sc&e-short;lesta ars, n&e-long;qu&i-short;tia UNCERTAIN :-- Hí Dryhtnes ǽ feódon þurh firencræft they hated the Lord's law in their wickedness, Exon. 66a; Th. 243, 21; Jul. 14.
